author: Irene_P

title: Ruth is a priceless gem. Go on the tour!
text:
I highly recommend this tour but, more specifically, you need to ask for Ruth. Everywhere I travel I hire a tour guide; and Ruth was, hands down, the best tour guide I've ever had. She has a gift for making history come alive plus she has a rare gift of being a gentle extrovert. She knows when to chat and when to be friendly, but she also can tell when to give the people on her tour time to reflect. 

We started outside the hotel called The Parador and she took us everywhere! We paused outside Charles V palace and the tales she told about him where hilarious but always with a touch of respect.
author: Sara_C

title: 2 fantastic custom tours of the Alhambra and Albacin
text:
Gaby is a fantastic tour guide who combines professionalism with a genuine warmth and passion for what she does.

She arranged and conducted a fantastic tour of the Alhambra and a separate tour of the Albacin district for my mother and me.

She was very responsive to emails, punctual and happy to adapt the tour to suit our requirements.

She also takes a mean photo!

I could not recommend her highly enough.
author: Dannihill

title: Spectacular visit with three children
